Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.Tribe
public class Tribe extends Object
Represents the collection of characters, buildings, and attributes owned by a specific player.

This class acts as the central hub for a player's tableau. It handles the logic for adding cards, calculating tribe-wide bonuses, resolving set mechanics, and generating a data transfer object (DTO) for network transmission using lightweight identifiers.

    • getSetCountOfDifferentCard

      public int getSetCountOfDifferentCard(int setDim)
      Computes how many complete sets of distinct character categories of size setDim the tribe possesses.

      The algorithm assesses the sizes of all individual character category lists, sorting them in descending order, and checks the minimum threshold achieved at the targeted rank.

      Parameters:
      setDim - the required minimum size (dimension) of the distinct card category set; must be greater than 0
      Returns:
      the total number of complete distinct sets currently held
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if setDim is less than or equal to 0

    • toDTO

      public TribeStatusDTO toDTO()
      Converts the current state of the Tribe into a lightweight TribeStatusDTO for client-side rendering. This method aggregates character cards into ordered tabular columns, flattens all building cards into a single array, and packs pre-calculated point/discount structures.
      Returns:
      a new, immutable TribeStatusDTO snapshot representing the current tribe state
